newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to prepare Malev share sale plan by Apr 30.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to prepare Malev share sale plan by Apr 30.

text.p: Hungary's government commissioned Privatisation Minister Judit Csiha to work out by April 30 a plan for the privatisation of the national air carrier Malev, a government spokesman said on Thursday.
"The deadline the government gave for the job to the Privatisation Minister is April 30," Elemer Kiss told a news conference.
Italy's Alitalia, which holds a 30 percent stake in Malev, is reported to be considering pulling out of the Hungarian air carrier.
Plans for the privatisation of Malev are expected to be finalised towards the end of the year as Hungary is in negotiations with Alitalia about the Italian air carrier's plans for its Malev shares.
The government have insisted majority of Hungarian owners in Malev should be preserved.
The state still has a 63.9 percent stake in Malev, and plans to retain 25 percent plus one vote.
